name: Quang Ngai
provinceNote: From 1 July 2025 the new Quảng Ngãi province joins the former Kon Tum and Quảng Ngãi provinces. Resolution 202/2025/QH15, clause 11, prints 14,832.55 km² and 2,161,755 people and does not name a capital. Decision 759/QĐ-TTg places the administrative center at present-day Thành phố Quảng Ngãi and prints 14,832.6 km² and 1,861,700 people. The national tourism bureau page still prints 5,152.7 km² and 1,246.4 thousand people (2015).
dotReason: The memorial and the river night are the reason to stop.
summary: The weekend night is the Trà Khúc, and the morning is the memorial at Sơn Mỹ. Phố đêm Sông Trà runs Tôn Đức Thắng from 17:00 to 22:00 on Friday, Saturday, Sunday, and holidays. Stay when that river night is the trip. Go to Hội An when the old town is the trip, or on to Quy Nhơn when the next coast city is. Mỹ Khê here is the sand 12 km east, not the beach in Đà Nẵng.
timeNeeded: One day for the river and Sơn Mỹ
fee: Sights bill separately. Check on arrival.
getThere: Chu Lai, about 35 km north, or Ga Quảng Ngãi. Road minutes are check on arrival.
seoTitle: Quang Ngai city guide — Son My and the river night
seoDescription: Stay for the Trà Khúc night street and Sơn Mỹ, 13 km northeast or about 12 km from Trà Khúc 1 bridge. Mỹ Khê here is not the beach in Đà Nẵng.
intro: You wake on the Trà Khúc, the river the city is built on, with fishing boats on the water and a long bridge span across the channel. On Friday, Saturday, Sunday, and holidays the evening is Phố đêm Sông Trà, about 300 metres of Tôn Đức Thắng, open 17:00–22:00. The provincial page runs that street from Công viên Thạch Bích to cầu Thạch Bích. A January 2026 report puts the stalls on the east side of the bridge. It opened the evening of 6 February 2026. An earlier line had said around 7 February. Stay when that river night, and the memorial at Sơn Mỹ, are the trip. Go to Hội An when the old town is the trip, or on to Quy Nhơn when the next coast city is.

Give a morning to Sơn Mỹ, in Tịnh Khê. The memorial covers 2.4 hectares at xóm Khê Thuận. The bureau dates the killings to 16 March 1968 and says you stop at the statue, then at the objects inside: a bronze tray with bullet holes, a child’s clothes and sandals, broken pots, a monk’s wooden bell, and a hair clip kept for eight years. The same page commemorates 504 people, and separately prints 47 at xóm Thuận Yên (thôn Tư Cung), 97 at xóm Mỹ Hội (thôn Cổ Lũy), 102 at the watchtower, and 15 at the cotton tree. The bureau’s distance is 13 km northeast. The library’s is about 12 km toward the sea from cầu Trà Khúc 1. The management page prints the phone 0255.3843222 and no fee. A taxi page prints about 20,000 VND. A flower-shop page prints free entry. Both unofficial pages print 7:00–17:00. Those hours are not the office’s. Check on arrival.

The swim is Mỹ Khê in this city, at thôn Cổ Lũy on QL24B, 12 km east: 7 km of fine, gently shelving sand, casuarina behind it, and sông Kinh beside it. Cổ Lũy Cô Thôn is that same shore, not a second beach. It is not Mỹ Khê in Đà Nẵng. The bureau names a 342 hectare plan with a hotel and a campsite. That plan is not an open resort. No beach ticket was printed, and a month when the water is calm was not printed either. The beach page puts Sơn Mỹ 3 km away and Sa Kỳ nearby, and cảng Dung Quất 16 km away.

Thiên Ấn is the seal-shaped hill on the left bank, at xã Tịnh Ấn. The bureau prints 100 m and a plaque Nguyễn Phúc Chu granted in 1716. The library prints 105 m, and a pagoda built in Ất Hợi 1695 by thiền sư Pháp Hóa, about 2 km from cầu Trà Khúc 1. The mountain, the pagoda, and the tomb of Huỳnh Thúc Kháng (1876–1947) were ranked a national relic in 1990. Châu Sa, on the way toward Sơn Mỹ, is an earth wall and a moat, not a standing brick tower. The bureau prints about 3 km of wall still traceable, about 4 m wide and 6 m high, and a perimeter of about 4 km, ranked a national relic in 1994. It is about 7 km northeast of the center on that page, and about 5 km east of Thiên Ấn on the library page. Fees and hours for the hill and the wall are check on arrival. High-speed boats for Lý Sơn leave Sa Kỳ morning and afternoon. One operator page prints about 18–20 km and 25–40 minutes by vehicle to the pier, in xã Bình Châu. The tourism page prints no kilometre, no crossing time, and no fare.
gettingAround: Chu Lai is the nearest airport, about 35 km north on the tourism transport page, which still places it in Quảng Nam. That page names Vietnam Airlines, Jetstar Pacific, and Vietjet on Chu Lai–Hồ Chí Minh City and Chu Lai–Hà Nội, plus a bus and taxis. Flight minutes and the transfer fare are check on arrival. The 2025 resolution merges Đà Nẵng and Quảng Nam into Đà Nẵng. The transport page has not been rewritten to that name.

Ga Quảng Ngãi is at 01 Nguyễn Chánh, phone 0255.3820280 on the transport page. Southbound, the unified table’s SE7 cells are Đà Nẵng 22:30 and Quảng Ngãi 01:16 the next day. SE1 cells are Đà Nẵng 13:29 and Quảng Ngãi 15:59, both marked the next day. A ticket site prints SE1 at Quảng Ngãi as arrival 15:56 and departure 16:01. The table prints one cell, 15:59. Fares and the table’s revision date are check on arrival. Northbound, SE8 cells are Sài Gòn 06:00 and Quảng Ngãi 21:01. The bureau prints 889 km from Hà Nội and does not print the minutes. Road minutes from Hội An, Đà Nẵng, and Quy Nhơn are check on arrival.

QL1A is the coast road. The bureau also names QL24A toward the highlands, Laos, and northeast Thailand. The transport page names the Quảng Ngãi–Đà Nẵng expressway and then QL24B toward the highlands. Those numbers are not collapsed into one road. Bến xe Quảng Ngãi is at 02 Trần Khánh Dư. The page names Chín Nghĩa, Bình Tâm, and Phương Trang at desks in the city. Fares are not printed. A taxi fare is check on arrival. Mỹ Khê is 12 km east. Minutes from the center are check on arrival.

stayAreas.name: South bank
stayAreas.summary: Sleep around Nghĩa Lộ and Thạch Bích when the river and the weekend night street are the point. Rooms in the center. No hotel brand is a pick.

stayAreas.name: Cổ Lũy and Mỹ Khê
stayAreas.summary: Sleep out at the shore when the swim is the point. The bureau’s 342 hectare plan names a hotel and a campsite. It is not an open resort.

eat: The bowl is don, a brackish bivalve from where the Trà Khúc meets the sea, the water locals call nước chè hai. Yellow and black shells are both named. The newspaper’s peak is May and June. A commercial page says morning or evening. Shells are scrubbed, soaked to drop the sand, and boiled until they open so the broth stays sweet. The meat goes back with sliced onion and rice paper. The cook on the newspaper page says fish sauce and xiêm chili are enough, because a small part called mật don is the sweetness. The area is the end of Trường Sa. No stall price is printed.

Kẹo gương Thu Xà and mạch nha Thi Phổ are the proverb on the ward page, with đường phèn and đường phổi from the cane fields. Cá bống sông Trà is named rimmed salty-sweet. Chợ Quảng Ngãi, for specialties, is at 159 Nguyễn Bá Loan on the airline guide. Market hours are check on arrival.
interestsBody: Sơn Mỹ is the reason many people stop. The memorial is in Tịnh Khê, on the road that also goes to this city’s Mỹ Khê.
The evening, when it is on, is Phố đêm Sông Trà on Tôn Đức Thắng, not a bar list. The swim is Mỹ Khê at Cổ Lũy, 12 km east, not the beach in Đà Nẵng.

Thiên Ấn is the hill, the pagoda, and the tomb of Huỳnh Thúc Kháng. Châu Sa is the earth wall on the way to the memorial. Sugar to take home is kẹo gương and mạch nha. The night street’s plan includes an OCOP and souvenir zone.

interestGroups.title: Son My
interestGroups.summary: The memorial in Tịnh Khê, for a morning on the way to this city’s Mỹ Khê.
body: Walk the statue, then the house of evidence. The bureau dates the killings to 16 March 1968. Inside, the page names a bronze tray with bullet holes, a child’s clothes and sandals, broken pots, a monk’s wooden bell, and a hair clip. Outside the fence, stelae mark the hamlet sites.

The memorial commemorates 504 people. The same page separately prints 47 at xóm Thuận Yên, 97 at xóm Mỹ Hội, 102 at the watchtower, and 15 at the cotton tree. Do not add those figures into a second total. The bureau’s distance is 13 km northeast. The library’s is about 12 km from cầu Trà Khúc 1. The management page prints no fee. Unofficial pages disagree. Check on arrival.

cards.title: Son My memorial
cards.summary: The statue and the grounds at Tịnh Khê. The office prints no fee. Check on arrival.

interestGroups.title: Thien An
interestGroups.summary: The seal-shaped hill, the old pagoda, and the tomb of Huỳnh Thúc Kháng, on a morning before the April–August heat.
body: The bureau prints the hill at 100 m, a plaque granted in 1716, and a national relic ranking in 1990 for the mountain, the pagoda, and the tomb of Huỳnh Thúc Kháng (1876–1947). The library prints 105 m, and a pagoda built in Ất Hợi 1695 by thiền sư Pháp Hóa, about 2 km from cầu Trà Khúc 1. Both heights stay. Both years stay. They are different facts.
Neither page prints a ticket or a gate hour. Check on arrival. Châu Sa, the earth citadel on the way toward Sơn Mỹ, is ramparts and a moat, about 7 km northeast of the center on the bureau page.

cards.title: Thien An pagoda
cards.summary: The courtyard on the hill above the left bank. Height is 100 m on the bureau page and 105 m on the library page.

interestGroups.title: Tra Khuc
interestGroups.summary: The river the city is built on, and the weekend night street on the south bank.
body: The day on the water is the bank, the boats, and the span. The evening, Friday through Sunday and on holidays, is Phố đêm Sông Trà on Tôn Đức Thắng, 17:00–22:00. A 2026 layout counts 72 stalls: 6 OCOP, 16 souvenirs, 40 food and non-alcohol drinks, and 10 alcohol stalls. The provincial page does not print that split. No entry fee was printed. On other nights the older night market has been stopped since 2021.

Don is the bowl at the end of Trường Sa, where the river meets the sea. The newspaper’s peak is May and June. Kẹo gương Thu Xà and mạch nha Thi Phổ are the sweets the ward page names to take home. Cầu Cổ Lũy is the bridge with the Don An Phú ground to its south, at thôn Phú Thọ. It is not cầu Thạch Bích. Mỹ Khê, the swim, is 12 km east: 7 km of sand, casuarina, and sông Kinh.

cards.title: Tra Khuc river
cards.summary: Boats on the river the city is built on. The weekend street is 17:00–22:00 on Tôn Đức Thắng.

faqs.q: Is Mỹ Khê in Quảng Ngãi the same beach as Mỹ Khê in Đà Nẵng?
faqs.a: No. This Mỹ Khê is at thôn Cổ Lũy, 12 km east of Quảng Ngãi city: 7 km of sand, casuarina behind it, and sông Kinh beside it. The beach in Đà Nẵng is a different shore. No ticket for this beach was printed.

faqs.q: What does the Sơn Mỹ memorial cost, and when is it open?
faqs.a: The management page prints the phone 0255.3843222 and no fee. A taxi page prints about 20,000 VND and 7:00–17:00. A flower-shop page prints free entry and the same hours. The fee is not chosen. Those hours are not the office’s. Check on arrival.

faqs.q: How do I get to Quang Ngai from Da Nang?
faqs.a: By rail, the unified table’s SE7 cells are Đà Nẵng 22:30 and Quảng Ngãi 01:16 the next day. SE1 cells are Đà Nẵng 13:29 and Quảng Ngãi 15:59, both marked the next day. A ticket site prints a different SE1 clock, 15:56 and 16:01. Fares are check on arrival. By air, Chu Lai is about 35 km north of the city. Flight minutes and the road minutes from Đà Nẵng are check on arrival.

season.label: Rain Sep–Dec
season.note: The tourism bureau’s climate line is an annual average of 25.5–26.5°C, a high of 41°C, a low of 12°C, rain from September to December, hot months April to August, and the coldest months January to March. A month when the Mỹ Khê swim is calm was not printed. Lunar rites move on the solar calendar, including the Hoàng Sa soldiers’ rite on Lý Sơn, on the 18th, 19th, and 20th of the third lunar month. Check on arrival for the day.
